name: travel-memory-sticker-card
title_zh: 把旅行照片变成一张可收藏的编辑部风格纪念卡
tagline_zh: 上传一张随手拍，得到横版大留白插画、六枚手帐贴纸元素、三个小英文关键词和纸纹质感——像从旅行杂志撕下来的一页。
tagline_en: One upload becomes a horizontal keepsake card: quiet editorial art, six journaling stickers, three tiny English.
desc_en: Transform a user-uploaded photograph into one horizontal collectible memory card with a large quiet editorial illustration, six integrated journaling-sticker motifs, three small English keywords beneath the left illustration, tactile paper grain, and deliberately clumsy flat color fields. Use when Codex needs to P图, edit, redraw, stylize, or turn a travel, street, landscape, lifestyle, portrait, o
why_zh: 不是滤镜叠加，而是重绘：把照片转成笨拙平涂色块+纸纹，贴纸元素嵌入构图而非浮在表面。
why_en: Not a filter—it redraws your photo into clumsy flat color fields with paper grain, and integrates sticker motifs into the.
limit_zh: 只吃单张横构图照片；竖图或多人合影会被强行裁切，人脸可能只剩半张。输出是静态PNG卡片，不保留原图分层。
limit_en: Only single horizontal photos; vertical or group shots get cropped hard—faces may be halved. Output is a static PNG card: no layers, no print-ready.
